propositions: Partial-clone fixtures consume 32.69 worker-phase seconds per test due to >100MiB object duplication across xdist workers and require real Git protocol negotiation with filter:blob:none proof that cannot be mocked.

Large-object guard tests (pack >140 MiB) must retain real Git server and incompressible objects to detect size-dependent pack behavior; protocol-only tests (negotiation, missing-object, reconvergence) are independent of object size.

Isolated ephemeral Git servers per test (separate ports, temporary repos, explicit teardown) eliminate worker cross-contamination and mutable state sharing, as validated in maintained projects (git/git, jelmer/dulwich, eclipse-jgit/jgit).

Splitting into one large-guard fixture (141 MiB, single xdist worker group) and small real-protocol fixtures (1 KiB, all workers) reduced setup time 85.2%, pytest wall time 69.5%, and aggregate CPU 80.8% without replacing Git protocol with mocks.
